colour; a small halo is added to include antialiased boundary pixels.  The

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
import artifact_io

CASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
START = 21                    # frame 22 in zero-based indexing


def mallet_mask(frame):
    a = frame.astype(np.int16)
    r, g, b = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]
    # Red rubber head. Restricting the ROI protects identical reds elsewhere.
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[:frame.shape[0], :frame.shape[1]]
    roi = (xx >= 88) & (xx <= 143) & (yy >= 60) & (yy <= 88)
    red = (r > 120) & (r - g > 32) & (r - b > 24) & roi
    labels, count = ndimage.label(red)
    if not count:
        return np.zeros(red.shape, bool)
    # Pick the expected compact head component.
    candidates = []
    for label in range(1, count + 1):
        y, x = np.where(labels == label)
        if len(x):
            candidates.append((len(x), label, x.mean(), y.mean()))
    plausible = [c for c in candidates if 100 <= c[2] <= 140 and 65 <= c[3] <= 84]
    if not plausible:
        return np.zeros(red.shape, bool)
    head = labels == max(plausible)[1]
    # Include subpixel antialiasing and the tiny contact shadow around the head.
    return ndimage.binary_dilation(head, iterations=2)


def build_video(source):
    out = source.copy()
    # Late frames 73--90 are essentially static here and preserve four phases
    # of the renderer's subtle 18-frame background variation.
    donors = np.arange(72, 90)
    for i in range(START, len(out)):
        mask = mallet_mask(source[i])
        if not mask.any():
            continue
        donor = donors[np.argmin(np.abs((donors % 18) - (i % 18)))]
        # Hard-copy the confidently occluded core. A one-pixel soft boundary
        # makes the patch imperceptible over the naturally smooth background.
        core = ndimage.binary_erosion(mask, iterations=1)
        fringe = mask & ~core
        out[i][core] = source[donor][core]
        if fringe.any():
            a = 0.82
            mixed = a * source[donor][fringe] + (1.0 - a) * source[i][fringe]
            out[i][fringe] = np.clip(np.rint(mixed), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    return out


def main():
    source = np.load(CASE_DIR / \"source_pixels.npz\")[\"rgb\"]
    assert source.shape == (96, 144, 256, 3) and source.dtype == np.uint8
    frames = build_video(source)
    # Contractually required output save; writes pixels.npz, PNG frames/player.
    artifact_io.save(frames, CASE_DIR)
    changed = np.any(frames "'!= source, axis=3)
    print("saved", frames.shape, frames.dtype,
          "changed frames", np.flatnonzero(changed.any((1, 2))).tolist(),
          "changed pixels", int(changed.sum()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
